tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Window and page background. Section legends sit on it, so a legend's own background is `ground`.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: One step up from ground: the chat column, the Board field, cards, composer, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Selected rows, other people's chat bubbles, segmented-control track, meter tracks. Body text on it uses `ink` or `ink-2` only.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines that separate regions: pane borders at rest, list dividers, the dotted remainder of a furrow. Decorative separation only; a control's border uses `edge`.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Borders of controls a person operates (text fields, checkboxes, secondary buttons). Never text. Holds 3:1, the WCAG bar for borders, on `ground`, `raised` and `sunk` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and every mark stroke, on `ground`, `raised` and `sunk`. Also the fill of primary buttons and of your own chat bubbles.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta, timestamps, counts, hints, Up next and Done glyphs. On `ground`, `raised` and `sunk`.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an `ink` fill: primary button labels, your own bubbles, agent avatars.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: State Live only: something is happening right now. Focus rings and the focused pane's border too. Never decoration, never a brand accent. Reads at 4.5:1 or better on `ground`, `raised` and `sunk` in both themes.

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text on a `live` fill (the LIVE tag on a screen share).

tokens.name: held
tokens.usage: State Your turn only: stopped until a person decides. Also the solo button in Music.

tokens.name: on-held
tokens.usage: Text on a `held` fill.

tokens.name: broken
tokens.usage: State Stuck only: failed, refused, or could not be proven. Also removed lines in a delta and the record-arm button.

tokens.name: on-broken
tokens.usage: Text on a `broken` fill (Leave call, destructive confirm).

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: App icon tiles and the cover's slab: a dark ground in both themes. Marks on it use `tile-ink`.

tokens.name: tile-ink
tokens.usage: Mark strokes on `tile`.

tokens.name: added
tokens.usage: Change mark only: added lines, bars, members. Never a state; Done is `ink-2`. Also lit segments of a level meter.

tokens.name: label-1
tokens.usage: User label and track colour (clay). Belongs to the user; never carries a state. Region fills mix it with `ground`.

tokens.name: label-2
tokens.usage: User label and track colour (slate blue).

tokens.name: label-3
tokens.usage: User label and track colour (moss).

tokens.name: label-4
tokens.usage: User label and track colour (heather).

tokens.name: label-5
tokens.usage: User label and track colour (straw).

tokens.name: label-6
tokens.usage: User label and track colour (teal).

tokens.name: label-7
tokens.usage: User label and track colour (rosewood).

tokens.name: label-8
tokens.usage: User label and track colour (graphite). The default for a new track.

tokens.name: provider-claude
tokens.usage: Claude models: the model's name in the composer, the transcript and the picker. An identity colour, never a state.

tokens.name: provider-opencode
tokens.usage: OpenCode models, wherever a model is named.

tokens.name: effort
tokens.usage: The effort level beside a model name. Max effort's usage warning uses it too.

tokens.name: tool-read
tokens.usage: The icon of a step that read something: a file, a listing, a page.

tokens.name: tool-command
tokens.usage: The `$` of a step that ran a command.

tokens.name: tool-edit
tokens.usage: The icon of a step that changed a file.

tokens.name: syntax-command
tokens.usage: Command names and operators in a command shown on a step.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Quoted strings in a command shown on a step.

tokens.name: context-tools
tokens.usage: Context taken by tool calls, in the context bar.

tokens.name: context-system
tokens.usage: Context taken by the system prompt and tools.

tokens.name: context-reasoning
tokens.usage: Context taken by reasoning.

tokens.name: context-messages
tokens.usage: Context taken by messages.

families.people: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.machine: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen at most: empty states, an edition's lead, the cover.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Brussels narrows the AI Act's research exemption

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Conversation, issue and pane titles; names in a message group.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Keep the renderer directory until the libwebrtc path is real.
styles.usage: Everything a person wrote or reads at length: messages, agent prose, story text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Sending the RTX logs in a sec
styles.usage: Rows in lists, previews, card text.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Anything a machine did or said: commands, paths, receipts, trail steps.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Meta beside a row: times, counts, sizes, the composer's to line.

styles.name: mono-caps
styles.usage: Group headings in lists and small section labels. Uppercase is applied in CSS, so write sentence case.

styles.name: legend
styles.usage: The name cut into a pane's top border.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to its label, chip padding, gaps inside dense rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items in a row; button padding block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pane padding, list row padding inline, gaps between panes.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Composer and dialog padding, gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a window.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margins in reading views (Dispatch, docs).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above an edition's lead and on empty states.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd hints, agent avatars, the live head, music meter cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Selected rows, chips, segmented items, music regions, board rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, menus, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panes, the composer, dialogs, windows.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles only; the joined side of a run drops to `radius-sm`.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Person avatars, counters, toggles.

stroke.note: Line weights. The mark's own stroke is derived from its size, not taken from here.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: List dividers and window chrome.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Pane borders, control borders, legend frames.

tokens.name: stroke-furrow
tokens.usage: Trail branches and board field lines.

shadow.note: Only for things that float above the window. Panes and cards never cast shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, the command bar, toasts, dialogs, the draft actions popover in Music.
